articleTitle: When Sleep Medications Stop Working: What CBT-I Treats That Pills Don't
imageHeadline: Sleep meds stopped working? There's a reason why.
imageSubtext: What cognitive behavioral therapy treats that prescriptions can't
pinTitle: When Sleep Medications Stop Working: What CBT-I Treats That Pills Don't
pinDescription: If you've cycled through Ambien, Lunesta, or other sleep medications without lasting results, cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) addresses the underlying patterns that pills can't fix. Learn why this evidence-based approach works when medications fail and what it actually treats.
